The back-streaming white neutron
beamline (Back-n) at the China Spallation Neutron
Source (CSNS)
Neutrons are produced via a 1.6 GeV pulsed
proton beam at 25 Hz to bombard a tungsten target.
The proton beam current was in double-bunch mode with
a 41 ns FWHM of proton pulse width and 410 ns
interval. A neutron energy spectrum of 0.1 eV - 400
MeV with a flux 1E7 n/cm2/s was provided.
The 103Rh sample with diameter of 30 mm, thickness of
1 mm, density of 12.30 g/cm3, and purity of 99.95%.
The C6D6 detectors, with low neutron
sensitivity, use Pulse Height Weighting Technique
(PHWT) to eliminate dependence on cascading gamma-
ray energy. The EJ315 scintillator and
photomultiplier tube enable a 10 ns response.
The length of neutron flight path is 76 m.
The Maxwellian-averaged cross sections (MACS)
calculated using the default TALYS parameters.
